runs.name: Default due date of 15 days instead of 30

readout.headline: Keep the current 30-day default due date; the 15-day test is likely better but the lift is below the 10% minimum worth shipping.
readout.summary: We tested a default invoice due date of 15 days against the current 30 days over a 32-day run with 30,000 users in each group. The 15-day test lifted invoices sent from a 10% rate to 10.5%, and there is a 97.8% chance it is better than control. However, the estimated lift is only 5%, below the 10% minimum lift worth shipping, so the decision is to keep the control. Support ticket rates were essentially unchanged between the two versions.
